name: Grungy Shop
desc1: This small, run-down store is filled with the smell of greasy candles
desc2: burning. The counter runs the length of the room, and a heavy iron
desc3: grille set between the countertop and the ceiling blocks people from
desc4: getting to the wares. The shopkeeper grins at you toothlessly from
desc5: behind the bars, gesturing vaguely at his wares.
